subject: Evaluation: Grafana Agent remote_write adapter for multi-tenant metrics
messages:
From: Grafana Cloud <grafana-cloud@grafana.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T15:12:00Z
Subject: Grafana Agent remote_write adapter — short evaluation ask

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the intro last month. Our integrations team has been looking at the remote_write use cases you mentioned (multi-tenant metrics forwarding + metric cardinality control). We put together a short adapter spec and a minimal test harness that exercises label rewriting and tenant tagging — attaching the spec.

Would Redwood be willing to run a quick evaluation: 48–72h POC where the Grafana agent forwards to a small Redwood staging endpoint so we can validate label stability, rate limiting, and cost characteristics? We can share a lightweight dataset.

High-level ask: 1) confirm decoding of Prometheus exemplars and histograms, 2) validate tenant isolation under short bursts, 3) measure per-tenant token/ingest cost impact.

If this is feasible, cc-ing SignalBridge (they built the adapter prototype) and Acme Obs (partner consultancy) so we can align on test plan and expected metrics.

Thanks,
Samira Patel
Integrations PM — Grafana Cloud

Attachment: grafana-remotewrite-spec.pdf

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor OBrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Grafana Cloud <grafana-cloud@grafana.com>, SignalBridge Integrations <eng@signalbridge.io>, Acme Observability Consulting <ops@acme-obs.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Grafana Agent remote_write adapter — short evaluation ask

Thanks Samira — looping in Marcus (runtime/ingest) and Vanessa (partner) to scope. High level we need answers on label rewrite rules, upper bounds on concurrent writes, and whether the adapter preserves exemplar fidelity for latency histograms.

Marcus / team — can you take initial ownership of the POC? Please review the attached spec and let me know what infra snapshot (k8s YAML, temp tokens, example dataset) you need. Vanessa, can you coordinate timelines with Grafana and SignalBridge — we should aim for a 72-hour window the week of Apr 19 if feasible.

Evelyn
VP, Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Attachment: grafana-remotewrite-spec.pdf (forwarded)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Connor OBrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Grafana Cloud <grafana-cloud@grafana.com>, SignalBridge Integrations <eng@signalbridge.io>
Date: 2027-04-12T11:36:00Z
Subject: Re: Grafana Agent remote_write adapter — short evaluation ask

Eve / all — read the spec, looks straightforward but a few notes from infra side: 

- Exemplar support: our ingest pipeline currently drops exemplar meta in the decode step unless the remote_write envelope includes the new exemplar flag. SignalBridge prototype appears to include that flag, so we'll validate with a small sample set.
- Rate limiting: propose we provision a dedicated staging route using a non-production model slice (dedicated cpu/gpu not required; metric ingest is CPU-bound). I'll deploy a lightweight HTTP endpoint in k8s that mimics production front-door for metrics.
- Label rewriting: we need a mapping table (Grafana -> Redwood canonical labels). Please provide expected mappings; fallback policy should be documented.

Requesting these artifacts for POC setup:
1) kube manifests for the Grafana agent config (remote_write config)
2) sample dataset (Prometheus exposition or series CSV) — small, with histograms/exemplars
3) presigned tokens or a short-lived token exchange flow for tenant tagging

I'll attach a short test plan and sample CSV to this thread. Proposed window: Apr 19 14:00 UTC — Apr 22 14:00 UTC. If that works, I'll schedule a 30-min runbook sync on Apr 18.

Marcus
Senior Infra Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachment: poc-test-plan.md; metrics-sample-set.csv

From: SignalBridge Integrations <eng@signalbridge.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Grafana Cloud <grafana-cloud@grafana.com>
Date: 2027-04-13T02:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Grafana Agent remote_write adapter — short evaluation ask

Thanks Marcus — quick clarifications from our side: 

- The adapter supports both basic bearer tokens and a short-lived signed header model. For the POC we can provide pre-signed tokens scoped to the staging route to simplify validation.
- Label mapping: we'll include a recommended canonical mapping file and a small script to transform labels for the Redwood ingestion model.
- Exemplar fidelity: sample payloads will include exemplars; we recommend running one histogram-heavy pass and one low-cardinality pass to exercise both code paths.

We'll drop two artifacts in the shared Drive by EOD Apr 14: 1) adapter-config.yaml (example grafana-agent config), 2) mapping.json.

— Jamie, Lead Engineer, SignalBridge

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Grafana Cloud <grafana-cloud@grafana.com>, SignalBridge Integrations <eng@signalbridge.io>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Grafana Agent remote_write adapter — short evaluation ask

Quick sync notes and next steps after review: 

1) POC window confirmed: Apr 19 14:00 UTC — Apr 22 14:00 UTC. Marcus will run the staging endpoint and capture ingest metrics; SignalBridge will provide pre-signed tokens and adapter YAML by EOD Apr 14 (they already uploaded adapter-config.yaml and mapping.json to the Drive).
2) Success criteria (agreed): exemplar preservation, <5% label rewrite mismatches, no tenant leakage on concurrent bursts, and a rough per-tenant ingest cost estimate (tokens/month).
3) Owner assignments: Marcus (execution + metrics capture), Vanessa (partner comms + scheduling), Graphics: Samira (Grafana) and Jamie (SignalBridge) for artifact delivery.
4) Deliverables: Marcus will post a runbook + raw metric dump to Drive; Vanessa will produce a one-page mutual action plan and send to partners by Apr 19 09:00 UTC.

Thanks everyone — please flag any objections ASAP. If none, Marcus: please confirm infra details and I'll send calendar invites.

Evelyn Hart
VP, Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Related link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/GC-RemoteWrite-POC
